scope_note: Everything under lucis.life. Session JWTs mint fine via POST clerk.lucis.life/v1/client/sessions/{sid}/tokens (60s TTL). BUT api.lucis.life rejects ALL member routes with 401 appCode E_401_Identities_00000 'No user found for auth user': a verified Clerk signup does NOT create a Lucis backend member/identity.
